Page 163 Cont.
Oct. 25 Sheila Hogon - 8 - Elboe broken three months ago - Now arm stiff Drs. preparing for re-breaking.
Mrs. Dorothy Szczepouski - 46 - To-day in Providence Hosp. - intes- tinal trouble - cancer feared ....
The Embargo -- keep it on - 87 Mothers in Wash. Mrs. Dumont - 47 - Gall-blader - heart. .. Deardore - 45 - non Cath. - Rupt. Apendix
1939, November
Page 164 Nov. 3rd Hugo Stratmann - 58 - Slight stroke ...
3rd Wm. Tribbey - 29 - drinking - in trouble ... domestic and etc.
4th Gail El. Caffery - 10 mo. - injured at birth and as yet not able to sit up.
Catherine Dicklaras - 55 - liver cancer and corosis .... fears oper- ation necessary.
5th Patricia Connaughton - 5 - diabetis
Vivian Stewart - 38 - nerve Break.
Canceled Stamps ....
Mrs. Amelia Ajope - 58 - going blind - one eye cataract other must have operation - scientificaly very little hope.
James Biendit - 4 - unable to talk more than single words ....
Marie Kremhelwer - 31 - Epylitic fits for more than 20 yrs .- begs for prayers that she may not need to go away anymore to Wa .....
Mrs. Marie Rock - 49 - dropsey and heart-trouble ... tapped twice ... Norene Redmond - 32 - Epiletic.
